steps.title: Read between the lines. Choose the best answer.

items.q: “a lot of people couldn’t understand why I was going abroad.” This tells you that in 2005 Ireland
“I used to spend all day ringing people up and getting nowhere .” Maria means
options: she could not afford the phone calls
none of the calls produced a job
she did not know where to call
items.answer: none of the calls produced a job

items.q: Joaquim says the job is temporary, “but now I’m here I think I’ll stay a lot longer.” This suggests he
options: has changed his mind since arriving
has been offered a permanent contract
items.answer: has changed his mind since arriving

steps.title: Now answer four of your own questions out loud, as if you were the expert.
Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ name people who do things — specialist, executive, producer, champion, decision maker
✓ describe qualities — ambitious, determined, talented, innovative, thoughtful
✓ keep the word order right in every tense — question word, auxiliary, subject, verb
✓ ask a subject question without an auxiliary — Who taught you? What made you…?
✓ put the preposition at the end — What are you working on?
✓ ask about experience — How long have you been…? What’s it like to…?
